what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Cruz Missile
summary: Narrower greenhouse through measured cabin stations and a tapered nose tip; 12-facet LOD0 tyres retain five-spoke depth. Front lamp wraps now clip onto the actual tub triangles, eliminating diagonal occlusion slits. At LOD1 the spoiler endplates retain both visible faces and their contour; hidden thickness funds the conforming lamps. Physics pivots are stored independently of visual extrema. Exported intact triangles: 1913 / 896 / 507 against 2800 / 900 / 600. Front-view cabin widths and nose taper improve; rear-view and small side-view silhouette regressions remain. The weighted score is essentially unchanged at LOD0 and improves slightly at LOD1/2. Lamp attachment is visually continuous after the projection repair; its side/fascia seam remains a visible faceted change in shading.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.
